remarks:
An outstanding opportunity for a buyer looking to renovate and create substantial value. Priced to reflect the work needed. 
Discover the possibilities in this spacious 5-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offering over 4,000 square feet of living space, set on a quiet dead-end street with a generous backyard and in-ground pool. This property offers an excellent opportunity for buyers looking for space, privacy, and plenty of potential to create a home of their own.

A major bonus is the impressive 25' x 48' detached workshop, complete with heat, a full basement, and 220-amp electrical service—ideal for a contractor, hobbyist, car enthusiast, or anyone needing substantial workspace and storage.

The home itself offers an abundance of living space and a layout with tremendous possibilities. While the property will require updating, the size, setting, pool, and outbuilding provide a rare opportunity to bring your vision and creativity to life.

Bring your imagination and make this large property your dream home! With the right updates and personal touches, 7 Division Street has the potential to become an exceptional property with room for everyone and space for just about any hobby or project.
